services.purpose: Identify supplied claim IDs linked to changed or unobserved local source files.
services.configuration: Operator selects the source root and existing baseline at process launch; callers cannot select paths.
services.input: Empty object; no caller-controlled filesystem locations.
services.output: Source Watch JSON report with byte statuses, supplied claim IDs, relative source paths and hashes.
services.limits: No source authentication, live-law monitoring, semantic verification, automatic claim mapping or legal certification. The client may transmit returned metadata to its own model provider.

reuse: Existing rights are unchanged. Public source visibility and this catalogue grant no new execution or commercial licence.
discovery_note: Project-specific catalogue, not an A2A Agent Card or a registered marketplace listing. No external collaboration or customer adoption is established.
